page.layout: One column of running text. In the left margin, beside the start of the second paragraph, one Greek marginal note.

main_text.p: Etus de certare, certò precio, in perpetuum domini iure obtinenda. atque hæc quidē de constructione dicta sint.

Διαίρεσις[?]Diærefis autem siue divisio est, cum genus in formas primùm, dein formarū formas ita dividitur, ut tādem ad individua perveniatur. quam quidem ratione Iustinianus, alijq; ante eum complures, in Iuris civilis Institutionibus tradendis tenuerunt. Ius enim primùm in publicum & privatum diviserunt: & cum privatum solum explicandū susciperent, tū id in naturale, gentiū, & civile partiti sunt: singulasque deinceps partes ad

page.notes: The running head is a decorative blackletter-style band that I could not read, so it is marked illegible. The first word of the page ("Etus") is uncertain. The left-margin note is Greek (Diairesis); the first letter is doubtful, so it carries [?]. "ad" at the lower right is the catchword and is not repeated in the text. No signature is visible. The spelling of u/v and i/j has been normalised as instructed; long s is written as plain s throughout. The ligature "q;" and the abbreviations are kept as printed.
